newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan lowers fuel oil bunker prices by $10/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan lowers fuel oil bunker prices by $10/T.

text.p: Taiwan's Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has lowered its bunker fuel prices by $10 per tonne effective January 22, a company statement said on Wednesday.

Posted prices for 180, 280 and 380 centistoke bunker fuel delivered at the ports of Keelung, Hualien, Taichung and Suao were decreased by $10 per tonne, to $134. Term prices were also cut $10 to $131 per tonne.
Spot and term bunker C grade were also lowered by $10 to $132 and $129 respectively. CPC is Taiwan's monopoly supplier of bunker fuels. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703082).
